verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or mechanism for opting out of telemetry, analytics, or usage tracking. Community comments only note that the privacy policy mentions sharing data with analytics providers, which says nothing about an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
